notes.title: Chrismas Time.!
notes.notes:
[b]Christmas[/b], a joyous occasion celebrated worldwide, commemorates the birth of Jesus Christ. Families gather, homes are adorned with twinkling lights, and the air resonates with festive carols. The aroma of freshly baked cookies mingles with the warmth of shared laughter. It’s a time for love, kindness, and the magic of giving. Whether you attend a midnight Mass or exchange gifts with loved ones, Christmas unites hearts in celebration. 🌟🎄🎁

“May your days be merry and bright, and may your heart be filled with joy this holiday season. Wishing you love, laughter, and all the magic of Christmas!”

[h3]Merry Christmass.!🎄🎄🎄[/h3]

notes.title: Monti: The Hidden Secret Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Monti: The Hidden Secret Devlog #1[/h1] 

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776072/c7d3c41b302bc887ceeead9a7ff1d97287107afa.jpg[/img] 
Hey everybody.! we are so happy to present you about what's happening on Monti:THS development progress. here is the first Devlog: 


[h2]Major Updates[/h2] 

[h3]1. From Unity 2020.2.7f1 to Unity 2023.2f1[/h3] 
In order to better optimization, new features, better debugging and many other things, we decided to move from v2020 to v2023. There is few bugs because of that and we are working to fix them. We also moved from URP 10.3.2 to 16.0.4 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776072/0c0ad4478a5ef928ce4e1a501dff39989df049d1.jpg[/img]

 [h3]2. Visual Improvements[/h3] 
In order to better storytelling and having an Eye-catching world, we have changed some visuals and backgrounds in Parala. We are also improving shaders and lights. here is some examples: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776072/790d3c4aa7153f846b163a00bc81bd3a592215ee.gif[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776072/f9d8cb5e784589615871718db6598478afecc15f.jpg[/img]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776072/476dc5dee95d1bbc5dec88f662f244f1295b3cdd.jpg[/img] 


[h2]Minor Updates[/h2]
[h3]1.User Interface[/h3] 
we had some interface problem in menus and in game that already fixed. 
[h3]2.Character Animations[/h3] 
there was some bugs around movements and attacks that doesn't exist anymore :) 


[h2]Ongoing Processes[/h2] 
We are working as hard as we can to give you THE BEST experience we can give you. so this is ongoing plans for future update: 
[list] 
[*] UI improvements 
[*] Better narration design 
[*] Character voice acts 
[*] Second zone bug fix and improvements
[*] Public demo (hopefully) 
[/list]
